answer: Each earning key must keep a live measured kernel subscribed to a public entropy river of per-second nonces. That kernel mixes every nonce with a per-key secret and emits a compact violet watermark that verifiers replay against the same river segment. Keys whose violet traces collide after replay are paid as one operator and lose a bonded slash. A farm cannot precompute the live stream, so cloning N identities means running N separate kernels and holding N real-time river subscriptions for the whole epoch.
